paragraphs: Elyo'einai ben Hakkaf, high priest, who prepared a red heifer in Choni the circle-drawer, Rabbi Yehudah ben Tabbai, and Shimon ben Shetach’s time. Chanamel the Egyptian, high priest, also prepared a heifer before Yishmael ben Pavi, Parah, chapter 3.
